Building Management In Norland, you only control the lordly family, while workers need their instructions to start working. You must assign a managing lord to the Hall, and the Hall's servants will distribute their instructions to buildings daily. If the manager is absent, they will be replaced. {split} Let's assign a manager to the Hall, where builders are stationed alongside the servants. 1. Select the Hall 2. Click the "INSTRUCTIONS" button in the building menu at the bottom left 3. Select a lord with the highest Management skill for the manager role. 4. Wait for the lord to issue instructions to the servants, who will then relay them to the workers. Peasant Mood By fulfilling the peasants' needs, you increase their average mood, which affects migration. An average mood above 50 will attract new workers to your city. Conversely, if the average mood falls below 25, peasants will leave and turn to crime. There are many ways to boost mood, such as alcohol, temple sermons, and executions, but often the simplest way is to eliminate negative thoughts. Let's find out what bothers them the most. $ Hover over the peasant icon in the top left corner. Books and Knowledge At the bottom, the strongest negative thoughts of the peasants are displayed, along with the number of characters affected by them. So, we see that they are troubled by tasteless Rutabaga. We can establish the production of higher-quality food, but for that, we need knowledge found in books. But where can we get them? This is where the Holy Caravan comes in. And we also need Gold. Books and Knowledge The Church maintains a natural balance of demand, so if you start selling too much of one item, its price will drop. But for now, there is a stock available. 1. Sell 30 units of your produced Moonshine 2. Buy the book "Rye Field and Mill" 3. Close the trade menu $ You can move more items at once by holding {input.action.gui_add_more}. Books and Knowledge Now that we have a book about growing Rye and producing Flour, it can be studied in the Library through the Knowledge Menu. {split} Books can be written in different languages, but most are in the Imperial language. 1. Open the Knowledge Menu 2. Assign a lord to study "Rye Field and Mill" Lord's Menu In the lord's menu, you can see their main attributes (such as Mood and Loyalty), inventory, and traits. Other tabs allow you to view their personality traits and relationships with other lords. {split} But right now, we can see that their mood is affected by a strong negative thought. You can hover over any icon or attribute to get more details. $ Hover over the thought to learn more. The Desire for Gold So, he is upset about an unfulfilled desire. If you hover over the desire icon (in the Strong Feelings section), you will see that this lord dreams of Gold - who doesn’t? {split} Let’s share some Gold with this lord by rewarding him, and in doing so, boost his Mood and improve his relations with our king. 1. Click the “Action” button 2. Select the “King” section 3. Choose the “Reward” action and select your King as the executor.
